sents.t: Last Thursday, I woke up at three in the morning with a terrible toothache.
The left side of my face was swollen.
In the morning, I called Dr. Kim’s dental office.
“We have a cancellation. Can you come at eleven?” the receptionist asked.
Before the appointment, I filled out a form about my health and my dental insurance.
Luckily, my job at the bookstore gives me insurance.
Dr. Kim was a calm, kind woman.
She took an X-ray of my teeth.
“You have a cavity, and it’s very deep,” she said.
“I’m going to fill it today. You won’t feel any pain.”
She gave me a shot, and my mouth was numb for three hours.
Then she gave me some advice.
“You should brush twice a day and floss every night. You shouldn’t drink so much soda, and you should come for a cleaning every six months.”
“How many lattes do you drink a day?” she asked.
At home, I tried to eat soup, but half of it went on my shirt!

comp.q: Why could Sam see Dr. Kim the same day?
comp.fa: چرا سام توانست همان روز دکتر کیم را ببیند؟

comp.q: Who pays for Sam’s dental care?
comp.fa: هزینه‌ی دندانپزشکی سام را چه کسی می‌پردازد؟
عکس رادیولوژی چه چیزی نشان داد؟

comp.q: What should Sam drink less of?
comp.fa: سام باید کمتر چه چیزی بنوشد؟

comp.q: Why did soup go on Sam’s shirt?
comp.fa: چرا سوپ روی پیراهن سام ریخت؟
